notifications.title: Faster voice is on; channel.json still says 0.92
notifications.detail: Your pace note is applied to every tech Short from tonight: the voice speaks at 1.0 (about 164 words a minute). Agents can't edit channel.json, so the new speed lives in generator/pack.py (OWNER_PACE) and overrides the 0.92 there.
notifications.fix: Optional: set voiceSpeed.short to 1.0 in channels/how-tech-and-ai-actually-work-chips-ai-p/channel.json so the file matches. Nothing breaks if you leave it.
